title: (Pwn2Own) Home Assistant Green aiohttp_client Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
description:
This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to initiate arbitrary server-side requests on affected installations of Home Assistant Green. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.
The specific flaw exists within the aiohttp_client module. The issue results from following HTTP redirects. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code in the context of root.
addtionnal_details:
Home Assistant has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at:
https://github.com/home-assistant/core/security/advisories/GHSA-6456-4qg9-cqpj
